mapper.select: SELECT CHILD_ID, CATEGORY, DATA, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_CHILD_REPORT WHERE CHILD_ID = #{childId}
SELECT CHILD_ID, CATEGORY, DATA, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_CHILD_REPORT WHERE CHILD_ID = #{childId} AND CATEGORY = #{category}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CHILD_REPORT(CHILD_ID, CATEGORY, DATA) VALUES (#{childId}, #{category}, #{data}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DATA = #{data}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_CHILD_REPORT WHERE CHILD_ID = #{childId} AND CATEGORY = #{category}
